messages:
isabel: Quick design drop for Prompt Sets > Eval Runs 1: adding inline triage tags on run rows (bug/question/urgent), a bulk-tag flow, and a 'Copy run IDs' action for quick JIRA creation. Fig: https://figma.com/file/triage-flow
 tom: Love the idea. UX Q: are tags inline chips or in a side panel?
 isabel: Inline chips on each row, editable. You can multi-select runs and apply a tag to all selected. Also a small tag picker (type-to-search) in the toolbar for bulk ops.
 dave: Microcopy nit: show chip label as "Triage: Bug" rather than just "Bug" so it's explicit in compact view. Tooltip: "Triage tag 1: Bug 1: route to bug queue".
 meera: A11y: chips need keyboard focus, aria-pressed true/false, and clear visible focus. When tagging multiple runs announce "Added 'Bug' tag to 3 runs" via polite aria-live.
 a11y-bot: accessibility recs: implement chips as <button role="button" aria-pressed="false"> with SR-only text 'Triage tag: Bug'. Bulk tag actions should announce summary: 'Tagged 5 runs: Bug'. For color reliance, include icon + text and ensure >=4.5:1 contrast or HC mode.
 tom: For Copy run IDs: copy as newline-separated, include header comment for paste into JIRA: e.g.
 ```
 # Run IDs (paste into issue)
 run_12345
 run_12346
 run_12347
 ```
 Toast: "Copied 3 run IDs. Paste into Jira or CSV." Also add keyboard shortcut (Cmd/Ctrl+C) when runs selected but scope it to the list to avoid clobbering global copy.
 isabel: Good examples. I'll add the sample format and scoped shortcut. Also thinking of an "auto-tag regressions" toggle in project settings so runs that fail regression automatically get 'Triage: Regression' tag.
 dave: Need ACLs: who can add/remove tags? Proposal: reviewers + admins. Regular viewers can suggest a tag which creates a pending-tag that a reviewer can approve. Helps governance.
 meera: If we allow pending-tags, make sure SR announces "Tag suggestion submitted" and reviewers see a badge. Keyboard path to approve suggestions must exist.
 a11y-bot: bulk-tagging low-quality runs: if any selected run is below the project's review threshold, modal should warn and optionally require a reason. Announce: 'Warning: 2 selected runs below threshold. Reason required.' Ensure reason input has aria-required and clear error messaging.
 isabel: Plan: inline triage chips (aria-pressed, icon + text), bulk tag picker (typeahead) with keyboard-first focus, copy run IDs (newline format + toast), auto-tag regression setting, ACL with pending-tag workflow, and threshold warning + required reason for low-score bulk tags. I'll update prototype and add a short a11y checklist for dev (focus order, aria-live strings, SR-only labels, keyboard shortcuts scope). Will post new figma by EOD :thumbsup:
 tom: tiny visual: ensure chips have min 40px hit target and adapt in compact mode (abbr to 'T:Bug' with full SR text).
 dave: And include a small history entry in the change-log when tags change: actor + timestamp + previous/new tags for auditability.
 meera: I'll run a keyboard & NVDA pass after the update and paste step-by-step SR narration examples for handoff.
 isabel: Thanks all 1: I'll iterate and share the updated link later today.
